notes.title: YJM Games' New VR Game Launch Discount Event
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31718379/7488ed0e3a719e8e2ff810b87bad267cc28160ab.png[/img]

Hi all,

YJM Games just launched a brand new VR game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/769640/Lordian_Karma/?beta=0]Lordian: Karma[/url].
It is a action defense VR games that can be played solo or with your friends in multiplayer mode.

To celebrate the launch, YJM Games holds a custom discount for other VR games including Inferno: Deathfield!

Check out all the games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=YJM%20GAMES]here[/url]!

notes.title: Feeling Lucky?
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31718379/8e64ace855452f819afc454f60bcb5dd430d0f1a.png[/img]

Top o’ the mornin’ to ya!

Only until [b]March 19th Pacific Time[/b]! YJM Games is having a 40% sale for all VR titles to celebrate [b]St. Patrick’s Day[/b]! 

5 VR games from YJM Games will be on sale starting from today:
[list]
    [*]OVERTURN
    [*]Smashing the Battle VR
    [*]Kart Chaser: The Boost
    [*]Inferno: Deathfield
    [*]Preta: Vendetta Rising
[/list]

This is your lucky time! Explore virtual reality world with YJM Games!

Check out all the games here >> http://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=YJM%20GAMES

Happy Gaming! :D

notes.title: [Patch Note] Monster Balancing
notes.notes:
Hi,

Shortly after the launch today, our dev team did some adjustment on the monsters balance. Please update the game before playing the game.

We are happy to hear feedback from you! Feel free to send us an email at infernocs@yjmgames.com.

Thank you! :)

notes.title: Inferno: Deathfield is Now Available for HTC Vive
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31718379/1f8bcdc3823716dc0808604cfccdfd9da3b158c4.png[/img]

Hi all,

We are so happy to announce that Inferno: Deathfield is now available for HTC Vive! 
Start your adventure in the medieval era and feel the excitement of hardcore combat action!

Have any question or feedback about the game? or just  want to say hi to the dev team? Send us an email at infernocs@yjmgames.com.


Happy gaming! ːsteamhappyː
